promise: Have 70% of American adults at least partly vaccinated by July 4, 2021
description: Biden set a national goal of 70% of adults with at least one dose by Independence Day 2021. Only about 67% had a first dose by July 4; the goal was not reached until early August 2021, and Biden conceded it 'was a tough month.'
evidence: Only ~67.1% of adults had a first dose by 2021-07-04
Target reached roughly one month late
